deferredToContractItem: the exact canonicalization and digest rules applied over the ratified analogue identity member list

binding.orderedMembersEncoding: orderedMembers is a JSON array of exactly eleven entries in OD-3 order; entry i is { memberId, value } where memberId is the i-th OD-3 member name and value is its resolved value. Array order is significant under CanonicalJSON/1; an object keyed by member name is forbidden because CanonicalJSON/1 key ordering would discard OD-3 order.

valueEncoding.KnowledgeCutoff: canonical UTC RFC3339 timestamp exactly as supplied by its governed source
valueEncoding.PriceBasisId: exact governed string; SPLIT_ADJUSTED only per OD-3

binding.calendarWindowBindingIdRulePerOD3: not a twelfth member; carried inside FeatureVectorBindingId and fails closed if not single-valued

notes: The identity input is an object carrying exactly the eleven OD-3 members; orderedMembers is rebuilt from ANALOGUE_IDENTITY_MEMBERS_V1 so input key order never reaches the digest, and a persisted orderedMembers array whose memberId sequence differs from OD-3 order is refused.

Member strings are consumed byte-exact: a value that is empty, not already NFC-normalized, or carries leading or trailing whitespace is refused, because CanonicalJSON/1 NFC normalization would otherwise merge distinct inputs into one identity.

Keys named in forbiddenInIdentityDigestPerOD3 (ticker, symbol, alias, temporaryAlias, any Outcome* key, HorizonId, distances, rankings, analogue set, classificationQuality, regimeVector and the six CORE_V1 value keys) are refused before digesting.

InstrumentIdentityId is matchable only when it was resolved at the same SessionDate it identifies (R0003 identityResolutionRule RESOLVE_AT_EACH_HISTORICAL_SESSION_DATE); a resolution made at any other date is alias backdating and is never matchable.
MissingnessStateId follows the GATE23 and GATE24 module precedent: GATE25_MissingnessState/1:<STATE>, first match in the order DISTANCE_FEATURE_INCOMPLETE, VOLATILITY_STATE_UNAVAILABLE, COMPLETE.

SelectionPolicyVersionId is sha256Canonical of the GATE25_SelectionPolicyVersion/1 payload over the D1, D3, D4, D6 and D7 binding digests, the CORE_V1 dimensions, the historical observation window, the pin set and the identity policy; EligibleHistoryPinSetId is the exact R0003 datasetIdentity string.
